questions.question: An article was marked at Rs. x and sold at a discount of (x - 40)%. If the customer paid Rs. (x - 32), then find the marked priced of the article
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Test the options to find the **Marked Price (x)** that satisfies the given conditions.

For **x = 80**: Discount % = (80 − 40)% = **40%**.

**Discount Value** = 40% of 80 = (40/100) × 80 = **Rs. 32**.

**Selling Price (SP)** = Marked Price − Discount = 80 − 32 = **Rs. 48**.

Check SP condition: **SP = x − 32** = 80 − 32 = **Rs. 48**. (Condition satisfied)

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 80.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Marked Price (MP)** = Rs. x

**Discount Percentage** = (x − 40)%

**Selling Price (SP)** = Rs. (x − 32)

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount %)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96b79e3faf3393adc1cee4b90e280e456718401b14a1a939db40827f1d1af398.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x − 32) = x × [100 − (x − 40)] / 100

⇒ 100 × (x − 32) = x × (100 − x + 40)

⇒ 100x − 3200 = x × (140 − x)

⇒ 100x − 3200 = 140x − x²

⇒ x² − 40x − 3200 = 0

⇒ x² − 80x + 40x − 3200 = 0

⇒ x(x − 80) + 40(x − 80) = 0

⇒ (x − 80)(x + 40) = 0

⇒ x = 80 or x = −40

⇒ Since price cannot be negative, x = **80**.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 80.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relationship between SP and MP

The **Selling Price** is obtained by subtracting the **Discount** amount from the **Marked Price**: SP = MP − Discount.

Discount Percentage Formula

The **Discount Percentage** is calculated on the **Marked Price**: Discount % = (Discount / MP) × 100.

Quadratic Formula for Roots

For an equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the roots are given by x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)] / 2a.</p

questions.question: In a circle, PQ and RS are two diameters that are perpendicular to each other. Find the length of the chord PR.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

PQ and RS are two diameters that are perpendicular to each other.

**Formula:**

(Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Perpendicular)²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67c4240712af2a82469847bf85e979bd2bbe56512fe323d9aa3bce0424bfd982.png] 

Let O is the center of the circle and r is the radius of the circle. 

∴ PQ = RS = 2r

In right angle ΔROP

⇒ (PR)² = (OR)² + (OP)²

⇒ (PR)² = r² + r²

⇒ (PR)² = 2r²

⇒ PR = √2 r

⇒ PR = √2 r × (√2/√2)

⇒ PR = 2r/√2

∴ PR = PQ/√2

questions.question: If sin θ - cos θ = (7)/(17), then find the value of sin θ + cos θ.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin θ - cos θ = 7/17

**Formula:**

(sin θ + cos θ)² + (sin θ - cos θ)² = 2

**Calculation:**

(sin θ + cos θ)2 + (sin θ - cos θ)2 = 2

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 + (7/17)2 = 2

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 + (49/289) = 2

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 = 2 - (49/289)

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ)2 = 529/289

⇒ (sin θ + cos θ) = √529/289

∴ sin θ + cos θ = 23/17

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Asin θ + Bcos θ = C then the value of 

⇒ Bsin θ - Acos θ = √(A² + B² - C²)

**Calculation:**

So, sin θ + cos θ = √{1² + 1² - (7/17)²}

questions.question: If in any triangle, the angles are in the ratio of 1 : 2: 1, then what will be the ratio of its sides?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of angles of a triangle = 1 : 2 : 1

**Formula:**

Sum of all three angles of a triangle = 180°

If N is divided into a : b, then

First part = N × a/(a + b)

Second part = N × b/(a + b)

**Calculation:**

Ratio of angles of a triangle = x : 2x : x

According to the question

x + 2x + x = 180°

⇒ 4x = 180°

⇒ x = 180°/4

⇒ x = 45°

⇒ 2x = 45° × 2

⇒ 2x = 90°

Now we can say triangle is a right angled triangle.

Triangle has two equal angles so, triangle has two equal side.

See figure, ΔABC is a right angled triangle

Let AB = BC = a cm, then

(AC)² = (AB)² + (BC)²

⇒ (AC)² = a² + a²

⇒ (AC)² = 2a²

⇒ AC = √2 a

∴ Ratio of AB : AC : BC = a : √2 a : a = 1 : √2 : 1

questions.question: A man buys an article for Rs. 3,200 and sells it at a loss of 12%. What is the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

A **loss of 12%** means the **Selling Price (SP)** is 88% of the **Cost Price (CP)**.

SP = CP × 0.88

SP = 3200 × 0.88

SP = 32 × 88 = ₹2,816.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,816.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: **Cost Price (CP)** = ₹3,200 and **Loss Percentage** = 12%.

Formula: **Selling Price (SP) = CP − Loss**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e6cabef0337ef14588ebffa5aef7044d850bd0dc5f0026b799065703227a915.png] 

⇒ Loss Amount = 12% of 3200

⇒ Loss Amount = (12/100) × 3200

⇒ Loss Amount = 12 × 32 = ₹384.

⇒ SP = CP − Loss Amount

⇒ SP = 3200 − 384 = ₹2,816.

⇒ Comparing with the given options, the result corresponds to **Option (2)**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,816.**

**__Additional Information__**

Selling Price for Profit

When there is a profit, SP = CP × (100 + Profit %)/100.

Finding Cost Price

To find CP when SP and loss are known: CP = (SP × 100) / (100 − Loss %).

Profit/Loss Percentage

Profit or Loss percentage is always calculated on the **Cost Price** unless specified otherwise.

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 75. By adding which number, will the average become 76?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 5 consecutive odd number = 75

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of all observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of 5 consecutive odd numbers = 75 × 5 = 375

Average of 6 numbers = 76

Sum of all 6 numbers = 76 × 6 = 456

Let the 6th number be x

According to the question

x + 375 = 456

⇒ x = 456 - 375

⇒ x = 81

∴ The 6th number is 81.

questions.question: The perimeter and length of a rectangle are in the ratio of 8 : 1, and the area of the rectangle is 1323 cm². Find the length of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Perimeter** to **Length** = 8 : 1 ⇒ 2(L + B) : L = 8 : 1.

On simplifying, 2L + 2B = 8L ⇒ 2B = 6L ⇒ **Breadth (B) = 3 × Length (L)**.

Area = L × B = L × 3L = 3L² = 1323 cm².

L² = 1323 ÷ 3 = 441 ⇒ L = √441 = 21 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Perimeter** (P) to **Length** (L) = 8 : 1

**Area** of the rectangle = 1323 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter (P) = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

Area (A) = Length × Breadth

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7685ec174a98bb1d4ec99459d8a230a8410b9922da5d466b7864a6a8b3cfbb0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Length** be L and **Breadth** be B.

⇒ P / L = 8 / 1

⇒ 2(L + B) / L = 8

⇒ 2L + 2B = 8L

⇒ 2B = 8L − 2L = 6L

⇒ B = 3L

⇒ Area = L × B = L × (3L) = 3L²

⇒ 3L² = 1323

⇒ L² = 1323 ÷ 3 = 441

⇒ L = √441 = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles. Opposite sides are equal and parallel. The **diagonals** are equal and bisect each other.

Diagonal Formula

The length of the diagonal (d) of a rectangle can be found using the Pythagorean theorem: d = √(L² + B²).

Perimeter and Area Relation

For a fixed perimeter, a **square** (where L = B) has the maximum area among all rectangles.</p

questions.question: Ramu works 4 times as fast as Somu. If Somu can complete a work in 20 days independently, then the number of days in which Ramu and Somu together can complete the work is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of **Ramu** to **Somu** = 4 : 1

Total Work = **Somu's Efficiency** × **Somu's Time** = 1 × 20 = 20 units

Combined Efficiency = 4 + 1 = 5 units

Time taken together = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Ramu** is 4 times faster than **Somu**. **Somu** takes 20 days.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = Efficiency × Time

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **Somu**
 20
 20
 20 ÷ 20 = 1
 
 

 **Ramu**
 20 ÷ 4 = 5
 20 ÷ 5 = 4
 
 

⇒ **Somu's** efficiency = 1 unit/day

⇒ **Ramu's** efficiency = 4 × 1 = 4 units/day

⇒ **Total Work** = 1 × 20 = 20 units

⇒ Combined efficiency of **Ramu** and **Somu** = 4 + 1 = 5 units/day

⇒ Time taken by both = **Total Work** ÷ **Combined Efficiency**

⇒ Time taken = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a task. If the ratio of efficiencies of A and B is x : y, then the ratio of time taken is y : x.

Combined Work Formula

If A can do a work in x days and B can do it in y days, then they together can do it in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the efficiency or the actual work done by the workers.</p
